---
name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''

---

**Describe the bug**
A description of what the bug is.

**Steps to Reproduce**
Where in the game and what you were doing when the bug happened, and if possible, steps to reproduce it - for example, play level 2 with ship Ferox, or fire a bomb during Commando mode.

**Files**
To make easier to reproduce the bug, please attach a zip file of your save directory, which contains the application log, a crash log if applicable, as well as your save file.
